phases.name: Round 2: full run of Android v10 on 16.9.0 (2611091), fresh install
phases.note: User, 2026-11-18: rerun on 16.9.0 (2611091) with the earlier app data cleared (uninstall + install of the TR build); Pro test subscription and credit packs may be bought on the test account when Google Play shows a test purchase. Setup first (run plan › Setup).

segments.name: Entry points, Demo page and Add Media
segments.note: Free tier is enough: nothing is charged. Fresh install (R2-0 setup): the Demo page and the first-run bubble are back. TC-030 (first-run bubble) is judged at the first panel open of this install, whichever row opens the panel first: watch for it from TC-030 on. TC-001 / TC-002 / TC-010 – TC-014 need the Demo page not yet dismissed; TC-014 (ticks 「Don’t show again」) goes last among them. Test videos from make-videos.ts in Movies/casebook-ve and Movies/VE test. One-way state (user, 2026-11-11): TC-014 and TC-013 both turn the Demo page off (Don't show again saves on Try It Now and on ‹), so TC-014 runs after every Demo page row and TC-013 runs last behind a reset (pm clear + Google sign-in, logs pulled first).

segments.name: Free account rows, then buy Pro
segments.note: Runs while the account is Free (read Mine's tier at the start). TC-095 buys the Pro test subscription on Google Play (user, 2026-11-18: approved for this run on the test account, only when the sheet shows 「Test card, always approves」 / a test purchase; never type a password). If the account is already paid when this segment comes up, the orchestrator runs it later, once the subscription lapses.

segments.name: Panel layout, first-run bubble and trim
segments.note: Paid (Pro) account. Nothing is charged. TC-030 ran in R2-a. Drag rows (TC-042, TC-214, TC-215, TC-216, TC-272) are judged from a screen recording (run-android.md › Judging a drag).

segments.name: Default settings, chips and Mode length limit
segments.note: Nothing is charged: read the CTA price only.

segments.name: Credit price, eligibility and purchase
segments.note: Prices are binding numbers (formats.md). Purchases on the test account are approved for this run (user, 2026-11-18) when Google Play shows the test card; low-balance rows stay Blocked.

segments.name: Price grid: every Mode × style × fps × resolution at 00:30 and the cap
segments.note: Nothing is charged: read the CTA price and 「Selected Length」 only, on the 12:30 1080p 30 fps video (ve-1230-1080p30). Prices are binding numbers.

segments.name: Generating, cancel, background task and notifications
segments.note: Charged: each Enhance costs its CTA price; record the balance before and after and the Credit Details rows. TC-100 style offline cases use device-android.ts wifi. Real footage (user, 2026-11-10): TC-110's 01:30 1080p 30 fps source is ve-real-0130-1080p30 (Movies/casebook-ve-real), so its Result in R1-f shows a visible enhancement.

segments.name: Recent task, Result and failure
segments.note: Uses the tasks R1-e made. TC-265 – TC-267 time the task with waitfor's seconds. Judge 「Result」 over 「Original」 on the real-footage tasks (ve-real-*).
